incident: Buzzing on Christmas Eve: Trigona Ransomware in 3 Hours

sources.title: Buzzing on Christmas Eve: Trigona Ransomware in 3 Hours - The DFIR Report (2024-01-29)
sources.what_it_gave: entry (exposed RDP with valid Administrator creds, no brute force), hops (RDP beachhead->file server 1, file server 2, backup server), exfil (Rclone batch scripts to Mega from two file servers), impact (Trigona build_redacted.exe staged + run over RDP, spreads via SMB), TTR 2h49m

narrative_before: In this December 2023 intrusion the DFIR Report observed a threat actor access an internet-exposed RDP host using legitimate default Administrator credentials (no brute-forcing; prior logins suggested an access broker). The actor deployed a toolkit (batch scripts, SoftPerfect Netscan, Rclone) to the beachhead, scanned the network and browsed shares. ~20 minutes in they RDPed to a file server, copied the toolkit over, staged Rclone, disabled Windows Defender and ran batch scripts (start - копия.bat) to exfiltrate file shares to Mega.io; they also RDPed to a second file server and re-ran the Rclone scripts. ~45 minutes after exfil they re-logged from a new IP and RDPed to a backup server, applying the same Defender-disabling commands. They staged a Trigona binary (build_redacted.exe) on each accessible host and ran it over their RDP sessions; Trigona also spread over SMB to network-accessible hosts. Ransomware executed ~2h49m after initial access (dual extortion).

detection_moments.description: Login to an exposed RDP host with valid default Administrator creds; toolkit + SoftPerfect Netscan deployed; shares browsed.
detection_moments.evidence: 'the login utilized legitimate credentials for the default Administrator account, with no evidence of brute-forcing ... initiated network scans using Netscan' - Trigona in 3 Hours, The DFIR Report

detection_moments.description: ~20 min: RDP to a file server, Defender disabled, Rclone batch scripts exfiltrate shares to Mega; second file server re-runs Rclone.
detection_moments.evidence: 'establishing an RDP connection to one of the file servers ... execute a batch script responsible for initiating the Rclone exfiltration process to Mega.io ... RDP to access a second file server, where they executed the Rclone scripts again' - Trigona in 3 Hours

detection_moments.description: ~2h49m: Defender disabled on backup server too; Trigona staged on each accessible host and run over RDP, spreading via SMB.
detection_moments.evidence: 'staged a ransomware binary on each of the hosts they had access to ... initiated the ransomware binary on each host through their RDP sessions ... propagating to all network-accessible hosts through ... SMB' - Trigona in 3 Hours

attack_path: login to exposed RDP with valid default Administrator credentials (T1133/T1078)
RDP to a file server; Defender disabled; Rclone exfil to Mega (T1021.001/T1567.002)
RDP to a second file server; Rclone re-run (T1021.001/T1567.002)
RDP to backup server; Trigona staged and run; SMB spread (T1021.001/T1486)
ambiguities: Hosts named by role only; victim sector not stated. Network-accessible hosts reached by SMB spread modelled as srv_1.
No on-host privilege escalation/credential dumping; the default Administrator account was valid from entry.
Moments are the report's own timeline markers, not a defender detection timeline.
